popup_accessAll: Kemlock can look for sign-in and code fields on every site. It reads nothing else.
popup_accessClick: Kemlock reads a page only when you open it from the toolbar button or the right-click menu.
popup_accessRefused: Access to all sites wasn’t given, so nothing changed.
popup_breachCheckDetail: Sends only the first five characters of a password’s SHA-1 to the Pwned Passwords range service, with padding. Off, nothing is sent.
popup_breachOff: Breached passwords are checked only while the breach check is on in Settings.
popup_buttonsOnPages: Button in sign-in and code fields
popup_buttonsOnPagesDetail: Asks for access to all sites. Without it, fields still fill from this popup and the right-click menu.
popup_codeAfterPassword: Offer the code after the password
popup_codeAlready: {name} · {account} is already in the vault. Nothing was added.
popup_deleteBody: “{name}” is deleted from this vault. Its code stays in Codes.
popup_forgot: Nothing can recover this password, because it opens only this browser’s vault. Remove Kemlock from this browser, set it up again and join sync, and every item comes back.
popup_fromPageBody: Reads the QR codes visible in the tab in front and adds the code it finds, with this site as its website.
popup_generatorNote: Made in this browser from its secure random source. Your choices stay in this browser and aren’t synced.
popup_healthNote: Worked out in this browser from your logins: nothing about it is stored or synced.
popup_locked: Locked. Type this browser’s password to open your vault.
popup_loginGone: This login is no longer in the vault.
popup_loginsNotSynced: Logins aren’t synced through Vaultwarden: they travel only through a WebDAV folder.
popup_lookAlikeTitle: This address looks like {site}, but it isn’t.
popup_lookAlikesDetail: No 0 and O, nor 1, l and I
popup_markUsedOf: Mark a backup code of {name} used
popup_needsSecret: A login needs a username or a password.
popup_noCodeFound: No code was found on this page. Open the page that shows the QR code, then try again.
popup_noCodes: No codes yet. Use Add a code on a site’s two-step setup page.
popup_noLogins: No logins yet. Kemlock offers to save one when you sign in to a site.
popup_noVault: Kemlock has no vault in this browser yet.
popup_problemOther: Sync stopped. Try Sync now, or sign in again.
popup_recentNote: Passwords Kemlock made and filled that no saved login holds, kept for 30 days in case the site’s save never came. They aren’t synced.
popup_rememberedNote: Sites you picked this login for with “Always suggest here”. Not synced.
popup_removalsBody: A sync that removes many entries waits for you. Check that nothing was deleted by mistake on the other side.
popup_removalsTitle: This sync would remove {count} entries. Go on?
popup_removeBody: This deletes this browser’s vault and everything Kemlock stored here, and forgets its sync sign-in. Your phone and the sync place stay as they are.
popup_saveAsLoginOf: Save the password of {name} as a login
popup_scanning: Looking for a QR code on this page…
popup_setUpAgainNote: Opens setup again, to choose another place to sync or to sign in again. Your items stay.
popup_signOutBody: This browser keeps its items and stops syncing. Nothing is deleted on the server.
popup_syncOff: This browser isn’t syncing. Sync keeps its codes and logins together with your phone’s.
popup_unknownSite: Kemlock has nothing for {site}. Open a login below and choose Fill login to use it here.
popup_warnBreached: This password was seen in data breaches. Change it on the site.
popup_warnNoCode: This site offers two-step codes, and no code is linked to this login.
popup_warnReused: This password is used by another login too. Change one of them on its site.
popup_warnWeak: A weak password: {strength}. Change it on the site for a strong one from the generator.
popup_wrongCount: Wrong tries since the vault last opened: {count}.
popup_wrongMany: {count} wrong tries since the vault last opened. The last was {time}.
popup_wrongOne: 1 wrong try since the vault last opened. It was {time}.
